summary.text: Seth Moulton is a Democratic member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Massachusetts.

paragraphs.text: He joined the Marines in 2001, led an infantry platoon in Iraq and served four tours there.
After returning home he used the G.I. Bill to earn joint degrees in business and public administration, and then became managing director of Texas Central, a high-speed rail company.
Moulton lives in Salem, Massachusetts, with his wife Liz and their two daughters.
